questions.question: How should questions asked on master or detached HEAD be handled?

options.label: Hold, promote on branch (Recommended)
options.description: Recorder writes them to a gitignored pending file; moved into the real log only when the same session next records on a work branch. Post-cleanup questions never get committed; pre-branch design questions survive (RFC-0018 D4.0 kept).

options.label: Never record on master
options.description: Recorder skips master/detached entirely. Simplest; loses design dialogs asked before a branch exists (amends D4.0).

options.label: Skip after a work branch
options.description: Record master questions only if this session has not yet logged on a work branch; skip afterwards. No pending file, but a session that closes one PR and starts a second loses the second's pre-branch questions.

questions.question: How should housekeeping on feature branches be kept out?

options.label: Opt-out tag (Recommended)
options.description: metadata.source='housekeeping' set by the agent, recorder skips it; skills hard-tag their stock chores. A forgotten tag means noise, never a lost decision. Probe first that metadata reaches the hook.

options.label: Opt-in tag
options.description: Only metadata.source='decision' is recorded. Clean by construction, but a forgotten tag silently drops a real decision.

options.label: Keep manual cleanup
options.description: No filter on feature branches; only the master fix ships. Pre-commit stripping per the memory note continues.

questions.question: Where should this be tracked?

options.label: New BK item (Recommended)
options.description: New item amending RFC-0018 (pending file + tag filter). BK-397 stays scoped to its /pr Decisions step and the two-branch remedy.

options.label: Fold into BK-397
options.description: Extend in-progress BK-397, which owns RFC-0018. The pending-file idea also touches its open two-branch remedy, so there is overlap.

questions.question: When should held master/detached records move into the committed log?

options.label: Recorder + commit (Recommended)
options.description: Promoted at the session's next dialog on a work branch AND by gate-commit.sh when that session commits on a work branch (it reads session_id from its hook payload). Covers 'design questions on master, branch, commit, no further dialog'.

options.label: Recorder only
options.description: Promoted only at the session's next dialog on a work branch, as BK-485 is filed. A session that asks on master, branches and commits without another dialog leaves its design decisions behind, uncommitted.

questions.question: Where should held records live?

options.label: sdd/decisions/.pending/ (Recommended)
options.description: Beside the log, gitignored by a new .gitignore line. Survives tmp/ cleanups; gate-commit's `git add -- sdd/decisions` skips it because it is ignored.

options.label: tmp/decisions-pending/
options.description: Inside the already-ignored tmp/. No .gitignore change, but tmp/ scratch is routinely deleted after a PR, which would drop held design questions before promotion.

options.label: Recorder + commit (Recommended)
options.description: Held records move into the log at the session's next dialog on a work branch, or when the session commits on one, whichever comes first. Design-then-branch-then-commit keeps its decisions.

options.label: Recorder only
options.description: Only a later dialog on a work branch promotes. Simpler (no gate-commit change), but design questions asked on master are lost when no further dialog follows the branch.
